citizenLead: Found an accessibility barrier? Our aim is to make it easy to report it and reach the right team.
proLead: A shared space for teams making places more accessible. Operational tools will be available in the next stages.
sceneBody: A little care. A small gesture. A clear path.
simpleBody: Designed for everyday use, on mobile and out in the field.
safetyBody: No report is worth putting yourself at risk.
accessibleBody: Clear interfaces, accessible by keyboard and designed with everyone in mind.
